items.html: Now, AVI, who are called the Hochma and Bina of Atzilut, take between the two of them only the Bina of MA, which is the phase of the Tagin of MA. And ZA of Atzilut and Nukva, who are the seven lower Sefirot of Atzilut, take the phase of the Otiot of the name MA, which are likewise the seven lower Sefirot of the name MA: the six are taken by ZA, and the seventh is taken by Nukva. Thus it has been explained well, the division of the ten Sefirot of MA within the ten Sefirot of Atzilut. And it is found that they are not aligned together.
